- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

  <style>
    .fur-outline { stroke: #202c2d; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

    .upper-body { transform-origin: 438px 465px; animation: shift-weight 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .tail { transform-origin: 408px 448px; animation: swish 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .head { transform-origin: 450px 343px; animation: look-up 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .eye { transform-origin: 466px 290px; animation: blink 7.2s linear infinite; }
    .scarf-ends { transform-origin: 428px 350px; animation: flutter 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .wheel-turn, .pedal-level, .near-leg, .far-leg, .juggling-hand { transform-origin: 0 0; }
    .wheel-turn { animation: turn 1.8s linear infinite; }
    .pedal-level { animation: counterturn 1.8s linear infinite; }
    .near-leg { animation: pedal-near 1.8s linear infinite; }
    .far-leg { animation: pedal-far 1.8s linear infinite; }
    .twinkle { animation: twinkle 3.6s ease-in-out var(--phase, 0s) infinite; }

    .juggling-hand { animation: scoop 1.2s ease-in-out var(--phase, 0s) infinite; }

      --follow-through: matrix(1.007, -.099, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --ready: matrix(.796, .007, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --catch: matrix(.824, .106, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --dip: matrix(.880, .204, 0, 1, 0, 0);

    .far-hand {
      --phase: -.6s;
      --follow-through: matrix(1.063, -.103, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --ready: matrix(1.195, -.006, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --catch: matrix(1.213, .075, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      --dip: matrix(1.149, .149, 0, 1, 0, 0);

    .bottle-y { animation: bottle-arc 3.6s linear var(--phase, 0s) infinite; }
    .bottle-spin { animation: bottle-flip 3.6s linear var(--phase, 0s) infinite; transform-origin: 0 0; }

    .bottle-shade { fill: var(--shade, #c67b38); }
    .bottle-mark { fill: var(--mark, #a65136); }

      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      25% { transform: rotate(1.15deg); }
      75% { transform: rotate(-1.15deg); }

    @keyframes shift-weight {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      30% { transform: rotate(-.9deg); }
      75% { transform: rotate(.65deg); }
    }
    @keyframes swish {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      35% { transform: rotate(3.5deg); }
      75% { transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    }
    @keyframes look-up {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      40% { transform: rotate(-3deg); }
      78% { transform: rotate(1.2deg); }
    }
    @keyframes blink {
      0%, 46%, 49%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
      47.5% { transform: scaleY(.12); }
    }
    @keyframes flutter {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      38% { transform: rotate(7deg); }
      75% { transform: rotate(-4deg); }
    }
    @keyframes turn { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes counterturn { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }

    @keyframes pedal-near {
      0%, 100% { transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); }
      12.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.1264, 1.0523, 0, 0); }
      25% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.2527, 1, 0, 0); }
      37.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.3051, .8736, 0, 0); }
      50% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.2527, .7473, 0, 0); }
      62.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.1264, .6949, 0, 0); }
      75% { transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, .7473, 0, 0); }
      87.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, .0523, .8736, 0, 0); }

      37.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, .4271, 1.1769, 0, 0); }
      50% { transform: matrix(1, 0, .3538, 1.3538, 0, 0); }
      62.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, .1769, 1.4271, 0, 0); }
      75% { transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, 1.3538, 0, 0); }
      87.5% { transform: matrix(1, 0, -.0733, 1.1769, 0, 0); }
    }

      0%, 100% { transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); }
      18% { transform: var(--follow-through); }
      50% { transform: var(--ready); }
      70% { transform: var(--catch); }
      82% { transform: var(--dip); }

      50% { transform: translateX(645px); }
